senses.gloss: प्रशंसन n. Praising, eulogising.
प्रशंसा f. 1. Description (as in अप्रस्तुतप्रशंसा); 2. praise, eulogy, applause, M.x.127; 3. fame, reputation, glory.
प्रशंसा-उपमा f. a kind of Upamā according to Danḍin who thus defines and illustrates- ब्रह्मणोऽप्युद्भवः पद्मश्चंद्रः शंभुशिरोधृतः । तौ तुल्यौ त्वन्मुखेनेति सा प्रशंसोपमोच्यते K.D.ii.31.
प्रशंसित a. (f. ता) Praised, eulogised, applauded.
प्रशंसित a. (f. ता) Praised, eulogised, applauded.
प्रशत्वन् m. The ocean.
प्रशत्वरी f. A river.
प्रशम m. 1. Calmness, tranquility, composure, R.viii.15, Kir.ii.32; 2. assuagement, appeasement; 3. abatement, extinction.
प्रशाम f. 1. Tranquillity, calm, composure; 2. quenching, extinguishing.

प्रशमन n. 1. Tranquillizing, pacifying; 2. soothing, assuaging, आपन्नार्तिप्रशमनफलाः संपदो ह्युत्तमानाम् Megh.i.53, 3. curing, healing; 4. extinguishing; 5. bestowing fitly, M.vii.56 (where Medhātithi and Kull. give this meaning to the word; Sarvajnyanārāyaṇa renders it differently); 6. securing, guarding, लब्धप्रशमनस्वस्थमथैनं समुपस्थिता R.iv.14; 7. cessation, abatement; 8. killing, slaughter.
प्रशमित a. (f. ता) 1. Appeased, composed; 2. quenched, extinguished; 3. expiated.
प्रशमित a. (f. ता) 1. Appeased, composed; 2. quenched, extinguished; 3. expiated.
प्रशस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Praised, eulogised, extolled; 2. best, excellent; 3. happy.
प्रशस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Praised, eulogised, extolled; 2. best, excellent; 3. happy.
प्रशस्त-अद्रि m. name of a particular mountain.
प्रशस्ति f. 1. Praise, eulogy; 2. a small poem written in praise of anyone; 3. excellence, eminence; 4. instruction, guidance.
प्रशस्य a. (f. स्या; compar. श्रेयस् or ज्यायस्; super. श्रेष्ठ or ज्येष्ठ) Excellent, praiseworthy.
प्रशस्य a. (f. स्या; compar. श्रेयस् or ज्यायस्; super. श्रेष्ठ or ज्येष्ठ) Excellent, praiseworthy.
प्रशाख a. (f. खा) 1. Having red branches; 2. in the fifth stage of formation (as an embryo.)
प्रशाख a. (f. खा) 1. Having red branches; 2. in the fifth stage of formation (as an embryo.)
प्रशाखा f. A small branch or twig.
प्रशाखा f. A small branch or twig.
प्रशांत a. (f. ता) 1. Composed, calmed; 2. subdued; 3. ceased, ended, प्रशांतशास्त्रार्थविचारचापलं (मनः) Bhartr.iii.(misc.)27; 4. dead, deceased, (pp. of शम् with प्र q.v.).
प्रशांत a. (f. ता) 1. Composed, calmed; 2. subdued; 3. ceased, ended, प्रशांतशास्त्रार्थविचारचापलं (मनः) Bhartr.iii.(misc.)27; 4. dead, deceased, (pp. of शम् with प्र q.v.).
प्रशांत-आत्मन् a. calm, peaceful, composed in mind.
प्रशांत-ऊर्ज a. weakened, prostrated.
प्रशांत-चेष्ट a. resting.
प्रशांत-बाध a. having all calamities averted, Kir.i.18.
प्रशांति f. 1. Quiet, composure, tranquillity; 2. cessation, rest; 3. quenching, extinguishing.
प्रशासन n. 1. Enacting, enjoining; 2. government.
प्रशास्तृ m. A king.
प्रशिथिल a. (f. ला) Very loose.
प्रशिथिल a. (f. ला) Very loose.
प्रशिष्य m. The pupil of a pupil, the disciple of a disciple, e.g. शिष्यप्रशिष्यैरुपगीयमानमवेहि तन्मंडनमिश्रधाम.
प्रशुद्धि f. Clearness, purity.
प्रशोष m. The becoming dry, aridity.
प्रश्चोतन n. Sprinkling.

प्रश्न m. 1. A question, a querry, an interrogation, (अविज्ञातप्रवचनं प्रश्न इत्यभिधीयते); 2. the subject of a controversy, a controverted point; 3. judicial inquiry; 4. in quiry into the future; 5. a problem for calculation; 6. a section of a book.
प्रस्न m. A vessel for bathing.
प्रश्न-उपनिषद् f. name of an Upanishad consisting of six questions and six answers.
प्रश्न-दूति f. a riddle, an enigma.
प्रश्रथ m. Laxity, relaxation.
प्रश्रय m. 1. Respect, courtesy, civility, modesty, R.x.70, 83; 2. love, affection.
प्रश्रयण n. 1. Respect, courtesy, civility, modesty, R.x.70, 83; 2. love, affection.
प्रश्रित a. (f. ता) Civil, courteous, well-behaved.
प्रश्रित a. (f. ता) Civil, courteous, well-behaved.
प्रश्लथ a. (f. था) 1. Very loose; 2. quite unnerved.
प्रश्लथ a. (f. था) 1. Very loose; 2. quite unnerved.
प्रश्लिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Entwined; 2. well-reasoned.
प्रश्लिष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Entwined; 2. well-reasoned.
प्रश्लेष m. Close contact, pressing hard.
प्रश्वास m. Respiration.
प्रष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) 1. Chief, principal, best; 2. standing or going in front, R.xii.10.
प्रष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) 1. Chief, principal, best; 2. standing or going in front, R.xii.10.
प्रष्ठ-वाह् m. a young bull being trained for the plough.
प्रस् vt. 4Ā (pres. प्रस्यते) 1. To bring forth young; 2. to expand, to spread, to diffuse.
प्रसक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Attached to, connected with; 2. adhering to; 3. devoted to, engaged in, applied to, (with a loc.); 4. obtained, gained; 5. eternal, constant, (pp. of संज् with प्र q.v.).
प्रसक्त a. (f. क्ता) 1. Attached to, connected with; 2. adhering to; 3. devoted to, engaged in, applied to, (with a loc.); 4. obtained, gained; 5. eternal, constant, (pp. of संज् with प्र q.v.).

प्रसक्ति f. 1. Devotion to, addiction to; 2. applicability, application, (अतिपसक्ति = अतिव्याप्ति q.v.); 3. union, association; 4. conclusion, deduction; 5. topic of conversation; 6. energy, perseverence, संतापे दिशतु शिवः शिवां प्रसक्तिम् Kir.v.50.

प्रसंग m. 1. Addiction to, devotion to, तस्यात्यायतकोमलस्य सततं द्यूतप्रसंगेन किम् Mrich.ii., K.S.i.19; 2. union, association, intercourse, (as in स्त्रीप्रसंग); 3. illicit intercourse; 4. reasoning, argument; 5. topic of conversation; 6. occupation, भ्रूविक्रियायां विरतप्रसंगैः K.S.iii.47; 7. contingency, event, case, K.S.vii.16; 8. mention of parents; 9. equal extent, inseparable connection (in logic); 10. a conclusion, an inference; 11. time, opportunity, occasion, सूक्ष्मेभ्योऽपि प्रसंगेभ्यः स्त्रियो रक्ष्या विशेषतः M.ix.5.(प्रसंगेन or प्रसंगतः ‘incidentally, by way of.’)
प्रासंग m. A yoke for training cattle.
प्रसंग-निवारण n. obviation of similar contingencies.
प्रसंग-वशात् ind. by the force of circumstances.
प्रसंख्या f. 1. Total number; 2. reflection.
प्रसंख्यान (I) m. Payment, liquidation.
प्रसंख्यान (II) n. 1. Enumeration; 2. renown, reputation; 3. reflection, meditation, हरः प्रसंख्यानपरो बभूव K.S.iii.40.
प्रसंजन n. 1. Connecting, combining, uniting; 2. applying, bringing into use.
प्रसत्ति f. 1. Transparency, clearness, purity; 2. favour, complacency.
प्रसंधान n. Combination.

प्रसन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Clear, bright, pellucid, limpid, K.S.vii.74; 2. pleased, delighted, गंभीरायाः पयसि सरितश्चेतसीव प्रसन्ने Megh.i.40, (where the word is used in senses 1 and 2), K.S.v.35, R.ii.68; 3. gracious, kind, propitious, kindly disposed, R.ii.63; 4. open, clear, easily intelligible (as the meaning of a passage); 5. true, प्रसन्नपायस्ते तर्कः M.M.i.

प्रसन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Clear, bright, pellucid, limpid, K.S.vii.74; 2. pleased, delighted, गंभीरायाः पयसि सरितश्चेतसीव प्रसन्ने Megh.i.40, (where the word is used in senses 1 and 2), K.S.v.35, R.ii.68; 3. gracious, kind, propitious, kindly disposed, R.ii.63; 4. open, clear, easily intelligible (as the meaning of a passage); 5. true, प्रसन्नपायस्ते तर्कः M.M.i.
प्रसन्ना f. 1. Spirituous liquor; 2. propitiation.
प्राशन n. 1. Eating, feeding upon; 2. causing to eat, M.ii.29; 3. food.
प्रसन्न-आत्मन् a. propitious.
प्रसन्न-ईरा f. spirituous liquor.
प्रसन्न-कल्प a. 1. almost quiet; 2. almost true.
प्रसन्न-मुख a. agreeable-looking, smiling.
प्रसन्न-सलिल a. having limpid water.

प्रसभ m. Force, violence, प्रसभोद्धृतारिः R.ii.30.(प्रसभम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) exceedingly, much, रामा हरंति हृदयं प्रसभं नराणाम् Rt.vi.25; (2) violently, forcibly, इंद्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरंति प्रसभं मनः Bg.ii.60.)
प्रसभ-हरण n. carrying off by force.
प्रसमीक्षण n. Deliberation, judgment.
प्रसमीक्षा f. Deliberation, judgment.
प्रसयन n. 1. Fastening, binding; 2. a net.

प्रसर m. 1. Free course, unimpeded motion, R.xvi.20; 2. diffusion, dispersion; 3. a flow, a stream, a flood, a torrent, पपात स्वेदांबुप्रसर इव हर्षाश्रुनिकरः Git.G.xi.; 4. a group, a multitude; 5. an iron arrow; 6. war, battle; 7. speed; 8. affectionate solicitation.
प्रसार m. 1. Spreading, extending, expansion; 2. spreading over the country; 3. stretching out.
प्रसरण n. 1. Running forth, streaming forth; 2. spreading abroad; 3. surrounding an enemy; 4. amiability.
प्रसारण n. 1. Spreading abroad, diffusing, expanding; 2. stretching out; 3. surrounding an enemy; 4. spreading an army in detachments; 5. the change of a semi-vowel into a vowel (in gram.).
प्रसरणि(णी) f. Surrounding an enemy.
प्रसरणि(णी) f. Surrounding an enemy.
प्रसर्पण n. 1. Going forward, moving forward; 2. spreading in all directions.
प्रस(श)ल m. The cold season (हेमंत).
प्रस(श)ल m. The cold season (हेमंत).

प्रसव m. 1. Generation, procreation; 2. child-birth, parturition, delivery, प्रसवोन्मुखीं प्रियां ददर्श काले दिवमभ्रितामिव R.iii.12; 3. offspring, progeny, young, वधूर्विधात्रा प्रतिनंद्यते स्म कल्याणि वीरप्रसवा भवेति K.S.vii.87, R.ix.28; 4. source, origin; 5. a flower, a blossom, गणा नमेरुप्रसवावतंसाः K.S.i.55; 6. a fruit, product.
प्रसव-उन्मुख a. about to be delivered.
प्रसव-गृह n. a lying-in chamber.
प्रसव-बंधन n. the foot-stalk of a leaf or flower.
प्रसव-वेदना f. the pangs of child-birth.
प्रसव-स्थली f. a mother.
प्रसव-स्थान n. a nest.
प्रसवक m. The Piyāla tree.
प्रसवन n. Bringing forth, fecundity.
प्रसवंती f. A woman in labour.
प्रसवितृ m. A father.
प्रसवित्री f. A mother.
प्रसव्य a. (f. व्या) Contrary, reverse, unfavourable.
प्रसव्य a. (f. व्या) Contrary, reverse, unfavourable.
प्रसह (I) a. (f. हा) Withstanding, bearing up.
प्रसह (II) m. 1. A bird of prey; 2. resistance, endurance.
प्रसह (I) a. (f. हा) Withstanding, bearing up.
प्रसाह m. Overpowering, defeating.
प्रसहन (I) m. A beast of prey.
प्रसहन (II) n. 1. Withstanding, enduring, bearing up; 2. defeating, overcoming; 3. embracing.
प्रसह्य ind. 1. Forcibly, violently, by force, प्रसह्य मणिमुद्धरेन्मकरवक्त्रदंष्ट्रांकुरात् Bhartr.ii.4, प्रसह्य तेजोभिरसंख्यतां गतैः Sis.i.27; 2. exceedingly.
प्रसातिका f. A kind of rice.

प्रसाद m. 1. Limpidness, purity, transparency (as of water), R.xvii.1; 2. composure, repose, absence of excitement, Bg.ii.64, 65; 3. good humour, gool temper; 4. favour, kindness, propitiousness, प्रसादसौम्यानि सतां सुहृज्जने पतंति चक्षूंषि Sak.vi., R.i.91, ii.22; 5. perspicuity, clearness of style, श्रुतमात्रा वाक्यार्थं करतलबदरमिव निवेदयंती घटना प्रसादस्य R.G., K.D.i.45; 6. a propitiatory offering; 7. remnants of food presented to an idol; 8. welfare, well-being.
प्रासाद m. 1. A palace, a mansion, e.g. प्रासादशिखरस्थो हि काकोऽपि गरुडायते; 2. a royal palace; 3. a temple.
प्रसाद-उन्मुख a. disposed to favour.
प्रसाद-पराङ्मुख a. 1. not caring for any body’s favour; 2. withdrawing favour from anyone.
प्रसाद-पात्र n. an object of favour.
प्रसादक a. (f. दिका) 1. Purifying, making pellucid; 2. gladdening, cheering; 3. courting favour.
प्रसादक a. (f. दिका) 1. Purifying, making pellucid; 2. gladdening, cheering; 3. courting favour.
प्रसादन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Rendering clear, purifying, फलं कतकवृक्षस्य यद्यप्यंबुप्रसादनम् (v.l. for प्रसादकम्) M.vi.67; 2. soothing, cheering.
प्रसादन (II) m. A royal tent.
प्रसादन (III) n. 1. Clearing from impurities; 2. soothing, composing; 3. pleasing, propitiating.
प्रसादना f. 1. Service, worship; 2. purifying, freeing from impurities.
प्रसादन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Rendering clear, purifying, फलं कतकवृक्षस्य यद्यप्यंबुप्रसादनम् (v.l. for प्रसादकम्) M.vi.67; 2. soothing, cheering.
प्रसादित a. (f. ता) 1. Purified; 2. appeased, propitiated; 3. worshipped.
प्रसादित a. (f. ता) 1. Purified; 2. appeased, propitiated; 3. worshipped.
प्रसाधक (I) a. (f. धिका) 1. Accomplishing, perfecting; 2. decorating, ornamenting; 3. purifying.
प्रसाधक (II) m. 1. A valet-de-chamber; 2. an attendant who dresses his master, R.xvii.22.
प्रसाधक (I) a. (f. धिका) 1. Accomplishing, perfecting; 2. decorating, ornamenting; 3. purifying.
प्रसाधिका f. A lady’s maid, a female attendant who dresses her mistress, प्रसाधिकालंबितमग्रपादमाक्षिप्य R.vii.7.
प्रसाधन (I) m.n. A comb.
प्रसाधन (II) n. 1. Accomplishing, effecting; 2. decorating, embellishing, toilet; 3. arranging; 4. means of decoration, things of ornamentation, K.S.vii.13, 30.
प्रसाधन-विधि m. decoration, embellishment.
प्रसाधन-विशेष m. the highest decoration, प्रसाधनविधेः प्रसाधनविशेषः Vikr.ii.
प्रसाधनी f. A comb.
प्रसाधित a. (f. ता) 1. Accomplished, completed; 2. ornamented, decorated.
प्रसाधित a. (f. ता) 1. Accomplished, completed; 2. ornamented, decorated.
प्रसारिणी f. Surrounding an enemy.
प्रसारित a. (f. ता) 1. Expanded, spread; 2. stretched out; 3. exhibited, laid out.
प्रसारित a. (f. ता) 1. Expanded, spread; 2. stretched out; 3. exhibited, laid out.
प्रसित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Bound, fastened; 2. devoted to, occupied with; 3. louging for, greatly desirous of, (with an inst. or loc.).
प्रसित (II) n. Pus, matter.
प्रसित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Bound, fastened; 2. devoted to, occupied with; 3. louging for, greatly desirous of, (with an inst. or loc.).
प्राशित (I) a. (f. ता) Eaten, swallowed, tasted.
प्राशित (II) n. A daily offering of rice and water to the Manes (पितृयज्ञ), M.iii.74.
प्राशित (I) a. (f. ता) Eaten, swallowed, tasted.
प्रसिति f. 1. A net, a snare; 2. a tie, a fetter.
प्रसिद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Renowned, famous, celebrated; 2. ornamented, adorned.
प्रसिद्ध a. (f. द्धा) 1. Renowned, famous, celebrated; 2. ornamented, adorned.
प्रसिद्धि f. 1. Fame, celebrity; 2. success, accomplishment, M.iv.3; 3. ornament, decoration.
प्रसीदिका f. A small garden.
प्रसुप्त a. (f. प्ता) Asleep, sleepy.
प्रसुप्त a. (f. प्ता) Asleep, sleepy.
प्रसुप्ति f. 1. Sleepiness; 2. paralysis.
प्रसू (I) a. Bringing forth, bearing, e.g. स्त्रीप्रसूश्चाधिवेत्तव्या.
प्रसू (II) f. 1. A mother, (प्रसूजनयितारौ ‘parents’); 2. a mare; 3. a spreading creeper; 4. the plantain.
प्रसूका f. A mare.
प्रसूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Begotten, engendered; 2. brought forth, produced.
प्रसूत (II) n. 1. A flower; 2. any productive source.
प्रसूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Begotten, engendered; 2. brought forth, produced.
प्रसूता f. A woman recently delivered.

प्रसूति f. 1. Procreation, generation; 2. bringing forth, bearing, delivering, R.xiv.66; 3. calving or laying eggs, नवप्रसूतिर्वरटा तपस्विनी Na.i.135; 4. a product, production; 5. a mother; 6. offspring, progeny; 7. a producer, a procreator, R.ii.63; 8. birth, generation, R.x.53.
प्रसूति-ज n. pain resulting as a necessary consequence of birth.
प्रसूति-वायु m. air produced in the womb during the pains of travail.
प्रसूतिका f. A woman recently delivered.
प्रासूतिक a. (f. की) Relating to child-birth.
प्रसून (I) a. (f. ना) Produced.
प्रसून (II) n. 1. A flower, R.ii.10; 2. a bud; 3. a fruit.
प्रसून (I) a. (f. ना) Produced.
प्रसून-इषु, -बाण, -वाण m. an epithet of the god of love.
प्रसून-इषु, -बाण, -वाण m. an epithet of the god of love.
प्रसून-इषु, -बाण, -वाण m. an epithet of the god of love.
प्रसून-वर्ष m. a shower of flowers.
प्रसूनक n. 1. A bud; 2. a flower.
प्रसृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Extended, stretched out; 2. spread, diffused; 3. engaged in, attached to; 4. swift, quick; 5. modest.
प्रसृत (II) m. the palm of the hand stretched out and hollowed.
प्रसृत (III) m.n. A measure equal to two palas.
प्रसृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Extended, stretched out; 2. spread, diffused; 3. engaged in, attached to; 4. swift, quick; 5. modest.
प्रसृता f. The log.
प्रसृत-ज m. a son born in adultery.
प्रसृति f. 1. Progress, advance; 2. the palm of the hand stretched out and hollowed; 3. a handful considered as a measure, Yaj.ii.112.
प्रसृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Hurt, injured; 2. laid aside.
प्रसृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Hurt, injured; 2. laid aside.
प्रसृष्टा f. A finger stretched forth.
प्रसृमर a. (f. रा) Dropping, distilling, flowing forth.
प्रसृमर a. (f. रा) Dropping, distilling, flowing forth.
प्रसेक m. 1. Oozing, dropping, flowing; 2. sprinkling, wetting; 3. vomiting; 4. emission, discharge, Rt.iii.6.
प्रसेदिका f. A small garden.
